# Original Issue-Orchestrator - licensed hook artifacts

This synthetic pilot redistributes generated Codex hook, Git pre-push and
verification helper source based on the original
[issue-orchestrator/issue-orchestrator](https://github.com/issue-orchestrator/issue-orchestrator)
at Git commit `d4a79824ccd806089cf3f70ec632d39b8ee255ea`, version 0.10.0.

The upstream source code is licensed under Apache License 2.0; the corresponding
unmodified upstream `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are retained in this directory.
The NOTICE also references software bundled in the full upstream application,
such as xterm.js; **no xterm.js code is included in this synthetic pilot**.

The pilot's new configuration and test code are separate from the upstream
copyrighted hook implementation. No upstream server, supervisor, or runtime
implementation is copied or forked here.
